Rhine Lab Ecological Section · Field Data Archival Terminal — record every sample, every inference
Press Ctrl+N to quickly log a new ecological record
Ecology Section Archive supports mixed Markdown and LaTeX editing — ideal for field data, culture parameters and academic deduction
Drag notes into category folders to file them, like moving specimens into their culture pods
Switch between light and dark themes in settings — for greenhouse daylight, observation nights, and those moments you'd rather not be interrogated by your screen
Ecology Section Archive is built on open source. View and contribute on [GitHub](https://github.com/Muelsyselove/Rhine-Lab-Ecological-Section)
